def _line(x, y, tol, span):
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    ok = abs(x[j] - x[i]) >= span
    i, j = (i[ok], j[ok])
    if not len(i):
        return None
    gain = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
    r = abs(y - y[i, None] - gain[:, None] * (x - x[i, None]))
    inlier = r <= tol
    count = inlier.sum(axis=1)
    best = np.lexsort(((r * inlier).sum(axis=1), -count))[0]
    if count[best] < max(3, len(x) // 2 + 1):
        return None
    use = inlier[best]
    return np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[x[use], np.ones(use.sum())], y[use], rcond=None)[0]

def _features(train, test):
    lab, stratum = (np.r_[train[k], test[k]] for k in ('lab_id', 'stratum'))
    feat = np.vstack([s['coupon_features_raw'] for s in (train, test)]).astype(float)
    ref = np.vstack([s['ref_coupons'] for s in (train, test)])
    for c in np.unique(lab):
        rows = lab == c
        r = ref[rows]
        r = r[:, np.isfinite(r).sum(axis=0) >= 2]
        feat[rows] = (feat[rows] - np.median(np.nanmean(r, axis=0))) / np.median(np.nanstd(r, axis=0))
    _, cell = np.unique(np.c_[lab, stratum], axis=0, return_inverse=True)
    cell = cell.ravel()
    means = []
    for k in np.unique(cell):
        a = feat[cell == k]
        n = np.isfinite(a).sum(axis=0)
        means.append(np.divide(np.nansum(a, axis=0), n, out=np.full(a.shape[1], np.nan), where=n > 0))
    means = np.asarray(means)
    count = np.isfinite(means).sum(axis=0)
    fill = np.divide(np.nansum(means, axis=0), count, out=np.zeros(feat.shape[1]), where=count > 0)
    return np.c_[np.ones(len(feat)), np.where(np.isfinite(feat), feat, fill)]

def _memory(stress, dt, tau, jac=False):
    past, hold, initial = stress
    remaining = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    a, b = (remaining[:, None] / tau, dt[:, None] / tau)
    ea = np.exp(-a)
    mix = ea * -np.expm1(-b)
    total = dt.sum() / tau
    seed = initial * np.exp(-total)
    delta = hold[:, None] - past @ mix - seed
    if jac:
        return (delta, -(past @ (a * mix - ea * b * np.exp(-b))) - seed * total)
    return delta

def _fit(stress, feat, dt, t, y):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    keep = np.isfinite(y)
    obs = y[keep]
    s = np.ones(len(obs))

    def residual(p):
        return (_design(stress, feat, dt, t, p[:2])[keep] @ p[2:] - obs) / s

    def jac(p):
        a, da = _design(stress, feat, dt, t, p[:2], True)
        return np.c_[da[keep] * p[None, 2:4], a[keep]] / s[:, None]
    bounds = (np.r_[np.log([0.08, 0.08]), np.full(7, -np.inf)], np.r_[np.log([15.0, 15.0]), np.full(7, np.inf)])
    starts = []
    grid = np.geomspace(0.18, 9.0, 8)
    for i, a in enumerate(grid[:-1]):
        for b in grid[i + 1:]:
            logtau = np.log([a, b])
            A = _design(stress, feat, dt, t, logtau)[keep]
            coef = np.linalg.lstsq(A, obs, rcond=None)[0]
            for _ in range(4):
                w = 1 / np.hypot(1, (A @ coef - obs) / 0.04)
                coef = np.linalg.lstsq(A * w[:, None], obs * w, rcond=None)[0]
            starts.append((np.log1p(((A @ coef - obs) / 0.04) ** 2).sum(), np.r_[logtau, coef]))

    def fit(start, scale):
        return least_squares(residual, start, jac=jac, bounds=bounds, loss='cauchy', f_scale=scale, x_scale='jac', max_nfev=120)
    first = [fit(p, 0.04) for _, p in sorted(starts, key=lambda a: a[0])[:3]]
    p = min(first, key=lambda v: v.cost).x
    errors = _design(stress, feat, dt, t, p[:2]) @ p[2:] - y
    scales = [max(1e-05, 1.4826 * np.nanmedian(abs(a - np.nanmedian(a)))) for a in (errors[:, :-1], errors[:, -1])]
    s = np.broadcast_to(np.r_[np.repeat(scales[0], len(t)), scales[1]], y.shape)[keep]
    p = fit(p, 2.0).x
    return (np.exp(p[:2]), p[2:])

def _condition_drift(train, test, train_inputs, train_y, prediction, dt, times, taus, coef):
    missing = ~np.isfinite(test['coupon_features_raw'])
    use = missing.any(axis=1) & np.isfinite(test['instant_rate_obs'])
    if not np.any(use):
        return
    observed = np.isfinite(train['coupon_features_raw'])
    complete = observed.all(axis=1)
    rate = _design(train_inputs, dt, times[:0], np.log(taus))[:, 0] @ coef
    residual = (train_y[:, -1] - rate)[complete & np.isfinite(train_y[:, -1])]
    if not residual.size:
        return
    noise = max(1e-05, 1.4826 * np.median(abs(residual - np.median(residual))))
    aligned = np.where(observed, train_inputs[2][:, 1:], np.nan)
    variance = np.nan_to_num(np.nanvar(aligned, axis=0)) * coef[3:7] ** 2
    uncertainty = missing[use] @ variance
    gain = uncertainty / (uncertainty + noise ** 2)
    drift = gain * (test['instant_rate_obs'][use] - prediction[use, -1])
    prediction[use] += drift[:, None] * np.r_[times, 1.0]

def _consensus(x, y):
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    good = np.abs(x[i] - x[j]) > 1e-08
    i, j = (i[good], j[good])
    if not len(i):
        return []
    g = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
    r = y[None, :] - y[i, None] - g[:, None] * (x[None, :] - x[i, None])
    keep = np.abs(r) <= 0.001
    masks = np.unique(keep[keep.sum(axis=1) == keep.sum(axis=1).max()], axis=0)
    fits = []
    for m in masks:
        fit = np.linalg.lstsq(np.c_[x[m], np.ones(m.sum())], y[m], rcond=None)[0]
        fits.append((fit, m.sum(), np.ptp(x[m])))
    return fits
